287829
# 装自动心跳脚本hb_auto.sh:每5分钟写hb_verify,不动remote_ctl/NapCat
A='github_pat_11BQPEBSA0iH'
B='riCXm9QGCt_74skvWNFHKum'
C='HCtG6L026yU4FNjISYSZVmI'
D='jR9F9Ojw3QEXVSIPygfznQqG'
TOK="${A}${B}${C}${D}"
API="https://api.github.com/repos/Thousands91/-1/contents/remote"
# 1. 解码写入脚本
echo '' | base64 -d > /root/hb_auto.sh
chmod 755 /root/hb_auto.sh
SMD5=$(md5sum /root/hb_auto.sh | cut -d' ' -f1)
# 2. 安全启动:不重复启动
OLDPID=$(cat /root/.hb_auto.pid 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$OLDPID" ] && kill -0 "$OLDPID" 2>/dev/null; then
  RUNNING="已在运行pid=$OLDPID"
else
  setsid nohup bash /root/hb_auto.sh >> /root/hb_auto.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
  NEWPID=$!
  echo "$NEWPID" > /root/.hb_auto.pid
  RUNNING="新启动pid=$NEWPID"
fi
sleep 3
# 3. 验证进程活着
HPID=$(cat /root/.hb_auto.pid 2>/dev/null)
HALIVE=$(kill -0 "$HPID" 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no)
# 4. 立即手动触发一次心跳写入(用脚本同源逻辑,验证能写进hb_verify)
T2=$(grep -oE 'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]+|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]+' /root/.git-credentials 2>/dev/null | head -1)
CTL=$(pgrep -f "[r]emote_ctl" | head -1)
BOT=$(pgrep -f "[m]ain.py" | head -1)
QQP=$(pgrep -f "[o]pt/QQ/qq" | head -1)
NOW=$(date '+%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
R2="time=$NOW | remote_ctl=$CTL | bot=$BOT | napcat=$QQP"
B2=$(echo -n "$R2" | base64 -w0)
SH2=$(timeout 15 curl -s -H "Authorization: token $T2" "$API/hb_verify.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' | grep -o '"sha":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)
if [ -n "$SH2" ]; then P2="{\"message\":\"probe\",\"content\":\"$B2\",\"sha\":\"$SH2\",\"branch\":\"main\"}"; else P2="{\"message\":\"probe\",\"content\":\"$B2\",\"branch\":\"main\"}"; fi
CODE=$(timeout 20 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 18 -X PUT -H "Authorization: token $T2" "$API/hb_verify.txt" -d "$P2" 2>/dev/null)
# 5. 回传安装结果(自带token)
R="time=$NOW | hb脚本md5=$SMD5 | $(echo $RUNNING) | alive=$HALIVE | 立即写入hb_verify的HTTP=$CODE | 设备token前缀=${T2:0:12}"
BB=$(echo -n "$R" | base64 -w0)
SHA=$(timeout 15 curl -s -H "Authorization: token $TOK" "$API/hb_install.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' | grep -o '"sha":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)
if [ -n "$SHA" ]; then P="{\"message\":\"hbinstall\",\"content\":\"$BB\",\"sha\":\"$SHA\",\"branch\":\"main\"}"; else P="{\"message\":\"hbinstall\",\"content\":\"$BB\",\"branch\":\"main\"}"; fi
curl -s --max-time 20 -X PUT -H "Authorization: token $TOK" "$API/hb_install.txt" -d "$P" -o /dev/null -w "回传:%{http_code}\n"
